note: No Current Password makes the core 'current password' field on the user edit form optional. It is driven by a single boolean config flag nocurrent_pass.settings:nocurrent_pass_disabled (install default TRUE). When TRUE, hook_form_alter on user_form and change_pwd_form hides the current_pass field (#access=FALSE) and sets $form_state->set('user_pass_reset', 1) to skip validation, for every account except user 1. Configure route entity.user.admin_form (/admin/config/people/accounts) exposes a 'Do not require current password' checkbox. No permissions, no Drush commands, no plugins. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config flag.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module nocurrent_pass makes the 'Current password' field on the user edit form optional. When its setting is on, what does it do to the user_form / change_pwd_form so core stops requiring the current password? Name the form_state flag it sets and how the field is hidden.
evals.expected_output: When nocurrent_pass.settings:nocurrent_pass_disabled is TRUE, nocurrent_pass_form_alter() calls $form_state->set('user_pass_reset', 1) (core's flag that disables current-password validation) and hides the field with $form['account']['current_pass']['#access'] = FALSE, for every account except user 1.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I enabled nocurrent_pass. Where do I toggle whether the current password is required, and what config object/key stores that choice?
evals.expected_output: Toggle it on the Account settings form (route entity.user.admin_form, /admin/config/people/accounts) via the 'Do not require current password' checkbox. The choice is stored in config object nocurrent_pass.settings under the boolean key nocurrent_pass_disabled.

evals.prompt: Two questions about nocurrent_pass on Drupal: after simply enabling the module (no further config), is the current-password requirement on or off by default? And is user 1 (the superadmin) affected by the module?
evals.expected_output: The install default is nocurrent_pass_disabled: TRUE, so out of the box the current-password requirement is OFF (removed) once the module is enabled. User 1 is always exempt: the module never hides the current_pass field for user 1 regardless of the setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live nocurrent_pass configuration and state whether the 'current password' requirement is currently ENFORCED on the user edit form (i.e. whether a user must type their existing password to change it).
evals.expected_output: It is enforced: nocurrent_pass.settings:nocurrent_pass_disabled is FALSE, which means the module does NOT hide the current_pass field, so core still requires the current password.

evals.prompt: This site has nocurrent_pass installed. Which config object and key control the current-password behavior, and what is that key's current value on the live site right now?
evals.expected_output: The config object is nocurrent_pass.settings and the key is nocurrent_pass_disabled; on this site it is currently TRUE (the current-password requirement is removed).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the nocurrent_pass module to make the 'Current password' field NOT required on the user edit form. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set nocurrent_pass.settings:nocurrent_pass_disabled to TRUE (via the 'Do not require current password' checkbox on /admin/config/people/accounts, or drush cset / config factory). Verify reads the flag and passes when it is TRUE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, restore core behavior so users MUST enter their existing current password to change their password/email. Use the nocurrent_pass configuration and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set nocurrent_pass.settings:nocurrent_pass_disabled to FALSE (untick 'Do not require current password', or drush cset / config factory). Verify reads the flag and passes when it is FALSE.
